articleHeadline: Enterovirus 71 in Vietnam: Monitoring rising cases and public health responses
articleSummary: Vietnam has reported over 34,400 cases of Enterovirus 71 (EV71) with 8 fatalities as of April. The country is experiencing increased activity, prompting health authorities to issue public guidance aimed at monitoring infants and schoolchildren for severe symptoms. The emphasis is on keeping sick children at home and maintaining strict hand hygiene to curb the spread. The situation is part of a broader regional trend, with neighboring countries like Taiwan and China also observing heightened enterovirus activity. The current focus is on preventing severe infections, particularly in vulnerable populations, as the peak season for enteroviruses approaches.
